name: BidSonar
description:
BidSonar gives Claude read-only access to the UK and EU public-sector market: live tenders, contract awards, grant calls, the buyers publishing them and the suppliers winning them.

Ask in plain English - "open healthcare contracts over £500k closing in the next 30 days", "what has NHS Property Services awarded recently, and to whom?", "Innovate UK grants for climate tech" - and Claude searches the directory, then links every answer back to the source notice.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- 100,000+ UK and EU contract and grant notices, around 2,500 added every week
- Six official feeds: Contracts Finder, Find a Tender, TED, eTenders Ireland, Innovate UK and UKRI
- 89,000+ organisation profiles — public-sector buyers, funding bodies and winning suppliers, with award history
- 18 sectors, plus CPV codes, regions, contract values, deadlines and award structures

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Search government contracts and grant funding by value, region, country, status and deadline
- Pull the full record for any notice: buyer, funder, value, CPV code, deadline and award detail
- Profile a buyer or funder — activity, disclosed spend, sectors, and every supplier they have awarded to
- See who holds the incumbency before you decide to bid, and find partners when you cannot win alone
- Check each source feed's freshness so you know how current an answer is

WHO IT'S FOR
SMEs and consultancies bidding for public-sector work; bid, BD and capture teams doing incumbency and competitor research; grant seekers tracking Innovate UK and UKRI calls; and analysts studying UK and EU procurement.

ACCESS
Ten tools, all read-only - nothing writes, edits or deletes anything. Sign in with a BidSonar account over OAuth and revoke access at any time, from BidSonar or from Claude. A free BidSonar account is all you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BidSonar to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BidSonar to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://bidsonar.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BidSonar MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BidSonar provides these MCP tools: get_funding_programme, get_opportunity, get_organisation, get_sector, list_organisation_suppliers, list_organisations, list_sectors, list_sources, search, and search_opportunities.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BidSonar?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BidSonar in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
BidSonar requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
BidSonar is developed by Hypership. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
